cm_help: Left: the category the store reports. Right: the name it should appear under – e.g. a SmartLists category. Empty = unchanged, ∅ = does not count as a category.
cm_empty: The sensors report no categories right now.
e_locked: Fix – cannot be switched in the card
e_cat_map: Link store categories (store category: category you want)
e_mine: Combined list: only consider my lists
e_add_to: Add to this list (empty = the list's default)
read_only: On this list you may only view or check off – adding and changing is not enabled for you.
cs_auto: from SmartLists, otherwise from the store
cs_store: from the store, otherwise from SmartLists
e_entities: Only these offer sensors (empty = all detected)
w_empty: Nothing here yet. Enter products you are waiting to see on offer.
w_local: Stored on this device. With "watch_list" (a to-do list) the watch list applies on all devices.
w_ha: Saved in Home Assistant – the same on all your devices.
w_err: The watch list could not be loaded from Home Assistant. Nothing was saved.
w_adopted: {n} products taken over from this device.
w_list_unused: Your watch list is now kept for you in Home Assistant. The to-do list “{list}” from the card settings is no longer used for it; what is on it stays there.
bonus_help: Bonus offer: you pay the normal price and get the credit in the {store} app – only if you use it at checkout.
e_bonus: I use bonus programmes (compare prices with the bonus)
with_bonus: with the bonus credit taken off
e_watch_list: Watch list as a to-do list (applies on all devices)
e_notify: Notify when something on the watch list is on offer
e_notify_service: Also send to (phones, services – several possible)
title: Offers
no_sources: No offer sensors found. Install e.g. one of FaserF's offer integrations (ha-rewe, ha-edeka, ha-lidl, ha-aldi, ha-norma) or add your own sensor under "sources".
no_list: No list selected – set a to-do list under "list" to match offers against it.
pick_hint: Tap a price to pick an offer
m_word: whole word in the name (butter ≠ butter biscuit)
e_max: Offers per store ("All" tab) – at most 20
e_sources: Sources are detected automatically. Own sensors and field mapping: in the code editor under "sources" (see README).
e_trend: Hint when an offer was cheaper or dearer before
wl_all_hint: All your watch lists together. New products go to your default list, removing applies to every list.
wl_private: Only you see your watch lists.
e_collect: Collect under "My list" first (＋ in "All offers" sets aside, "My list" adds to the list)
w_user: Kept in Home Assistant – only for you, on all your devices.
w_todo_hint: The products move to a to-do list, and this card shows them for you from there. All Home Assistant users can see a to-do list.
w_todo_fail: The to-do list could not be created.
w_todo_none: There is no to-do list to choose. Only admins can create a new one.
w_linked: Your watch list is kept in the to-do list "{list}".
e_show_title: Show title and number of offers
sh_connect_sub: Then you see here what you added from the offers.
sh_empty: The list is empty. ＋ under "All offers" adds something.
e_preview_start: A preview without a date starts on (if the store gives no end of the current offers)
